name: Raise ingress timeout
description: Raises the ingress timeout on carepath-api-green from 30s to 120s. The workaround used before the paging fix shipped.

name: Restart export worker
description: Restarts the FHIR bulk export worker and drains its queue. Safe to run during business hours.

name: Flush consent cache
description: Clears cached consent decisions so a regranted consent takes effect immediately.

name: Roll back carepath-api-green release
description: Redeploys the previous release of carepath-api-green through the standard change flow.
